message.content:
This editorial illustration is the cover of "TEMPO" magazine, edition "21-27 MEI 2012". The upper section features a black background with white text including "NEGARA RUGI RP 179,56 MILIAR DI TENABANG", "POLA KEJAHATAN PAJAK DHANA WIDYATMIKA", and "BANCAKAN RP 7,7 TRILIUN ANGGOTA BANGGAR". Below the large white masthead, a grey-toned person sits in an airport control tower, viewed from behind. They hold a mug and look out through large, angled glass windows. On the desk are binoculars and a microphone.

Outside, multiple white airplanes with blue and red markings are crowded haphazardly on a light grey tarmac. Numerous small, stylized figures walk between the planes. Ground vehicles, including small orange tractors and a bus, are scattered throughout. Large red text overlaid on the scene reads "SOS MENARA BANDARA". The bottom left contains a barcode, "RP 29.700", and contact information. The scene is framed by a thick red border on the left and a thin red strip along the bottom.
